responsibility: Implements small utility wrappers around TyTy types and references. In particular it provides TyVar, a context-backed handle for referencing already registered types and creating implicit inference variables or cloned/monomorphized type references, and TyWithLocation, the pairing of a TyTy node with source location information used by unification and coercion diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the executable helper logic for this stem, such as TyVar context lookups, implicit inference-variable creation, cloning/monomorphized cloning, and TyWithLocation constructors; the header only declares those lightweight utility wrappers.
